definition: Beamdog's edition combining Neverwinter Nights Diamond Edition content with enhanced features.
cultural_caution: An edition/package boundary, not a character and not a claim of parity across every platform or patch.

supports: Enhanced Edition and Diamond Edition content framing

definition: The campaign in which a player-created hero seeks a cure for a cursed plague ravaging Neverwinter.
cultural_caution: A campaign premise, not a source for individually unprofiled NPC claims.

citations.locator: Key Features: The original Neverwinter Nights campaign

definition: An included expansion in which the player is charged to recover four ancient artifacts and travels from the Silver Marches.
cultural_caution: An expansion scope term; player choices and unnamed/unsupported cast are not promoted to nodes.

citations.locator: Key Features: Two expansion packs—Shadows of Undrentide

definition: An included expansion that continues Shadows of Undrentide and enters the depths of Undermountain to challenge a gathering evil.
cultural_caution: An expansion scope term, not a fixed claim about outcome, characters, or all editions.

citations.locator: Key Features: Two expansion packs—Hordes of the Underdark

definition: Additional packaged stories whose exact included list differs between PC/Mac/Linux and console editions according to Beamdog's product page.
cultural_caution: Package/platform content, not a unified canonical campaign or a character cohort.

citations.locator: Key Features: premium modules for PC/Mac/Linux and console

definition: Windows-only authoring tool for creating and sharing worlds, monsters, items, traps, encounters, and settings.
cultural_caution: A user-authoring system; its output is not a single fixed official continuity or cast.

definition: Windows-only system allowing a storyteller to control monsters, creatures, and characters encountered in an adventure.
cultural_caution: A gameplay/authoring tool, not a named dramatic individual or an assertion that its controlled entities are canonical.

supports: Dungeon Master Client function and Windows-only availability

definition: The Dungeons & Dragons setting to which Beamdog invites players to return in Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition.
cultural_caution: A licensed setting term, not a character endpoint or a full source hierarchy for other Forgotten Realms works.

definition: The role-playing-game framework named by Beamdog for the included adventures.
cultural_caution: A rules/license framework, not a character source and not a claim that every tabletop rule carries over unchanged.

citations.locator: Opening product description and Story section

definition: Enhanced Edition feature support for save games, modules, and mods from the original Neverwinter Nights.
cultural_caution: Compatibility does not merge original or user-created module continuities into this product-pass cast.

supports: Compatibility with original save games, modules, and mods
